meta.parties: Fonseka Et Al. v. Narayanan Chetty

rules.statement: A non-notarial agreement can modify a notarial mortgage bond, but the modification must not affect the security or immovable property involved.
rules.supporting_quote: "Herein lies, to my mind, the distinction between that case and this. The writing in question not only changes the mode of payment of the debt, but increases its burden, with the result that now the plaintiff owes Rs. 1,177.50 instead of a smaller sum. The further effect of this is to make the security bear a larger debt, and consequently, I think; the agreement does affect the lands or immovable property mortgaged by plaintiff."
